      How this works

      For each reviewed degree plan, we start from its published starting route and run the same course planner used by your plan worksheet with your finished courses. A course counts toward a plan only when it matches one of the course options that plan lists from the school’s published sources. A course you type yourself matches only when its provider and course code point to exactly one listed course.

      “Could fill” means a proposed placement. It is not a transfer award. Grades, course age, credit limits and residency rules can still change what a school accepts.

      Planning estimates use the same reviewed rates as the plan worksheet: tuition, fees and outside course prices before financial aid. When a plan has any price we haven’t reviewed, we say the cost needs confirmation instead of guessing.

      Your courses are checked in this browser. Nothing is uploaded, and nothing is saved to My courses unless you choose Save.
